title: Why Do We Dream? The Brain's Midnight Movie Theater!

lines.text: Tonight while you sleep peacefully, your brain will open a magical 3D movie theater!
lines.caps: Tonight while you sleep *PEACEFULLY, | your brain will open a *MAGICAL | movie *THEATER!

lines.text: You might fly over skyscrapers or chat with talking purple puppies!
lines.caps: You might fly over *SKYSCRAPERS | or chat with talking purple *PUPPIES!

lines.text: Why does your brain create wild, colorful stories while your body is completely asleep?
lines.caps: Why does your brain create *WILD | stories while your body is *ASLEEP?

lines.text: Deep in sleep, you enter a special stage called REM—Rapid Eye Movement!
lines.caps: Deep in sleep, you enter *REM— | Rapid Eye *MOVEMENT!

lines.text: Your brain acts like a busy librarian, sorting through every memory from your day!
lines.caps: Your brain acts like a *LIBRARIAN, | sorting through every *MEMORY | from your *DAY!

lines.text: It files away the math you learned and the funny joke your friend told!
lines.caps: It files away the *MATH you learned | and the funny *JOKE | your friend *TOLD!

lines.text: As memories weave together, your imagination sparks, painting dreams across your mind!
lines.caps: As memories weave *TOGETHER, | your imagination paints *DREAMS | across your *MIND!

lines.text: Good sleep organizes your brain so you wake up sharp, happy, and energized!
lines.caps: Good sleep organizes your *BRAIN | so you wake up *SHARP | and *HAPPY!

lines.text: Dream big every night—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
